sources.title: LTX 2.5 on Comfy: Open-Source AI Video Model
sources.snippet: LTX 2.5 is here LTX is the fastest video generation model on the planet, and this version sharpens prompt adherence, visuals, and audio quality across the board. With a new Diffusion Fidelity Rendering capability, fine textures, faces, and complex shots hold up at cinematic-grade detail.
